# Components

<!-- Generated by generate-indexes.mjs; edit contracts, then regenerate. -->

- **Autocomplete**
  - Description: Autocomplete lets the user pick one option from a list of any length by typing
    to filter it, with the list shown in a popup.

    The system owns Autocomplete so that every typed single choice in the product has
    the same filtering, highlighting and listbox semantics. The consumer supplies
    the options and the label; the filtering and the roles are the system's.
  - Contract: [contract](components/autocomplete.md)

- **Combobox**
  - Description: Combobox lets the user pick one option from a list of any length by typing
    to filter it, with the list shown inline.

    The system owns Combobox so that every typed single choice in the product has
    the same filtering, highlighting and listbox semantics. The consumer supplies
    the options and the label; the filtering and the roles are the system's.
  - Contract: [contract](components/combobox.md)

- **CountryPicker**
  - Description: CountryPicker lets the user pick one country by typing to filter a supplied
    country list, with the list shown in a popup.

    The system owns CountryPicker so country fields use a consistent single
    selection model. The consumer supplies the country list and form field name.
  - Contract: [contract](components/country-picker.md)
